 Firehouse 51's Captain and newest recruit were M.I.A. shortly after an exciting promotion.
 By Jessica White Nov 19, 2026, 2:25 PM ET Severide Leads Intense Rescue for Pinned Motorcyclist | Chicago Fire Now Playing 2:04 Highlight Severide Leads Intense Rescue for Pinned Motorcyclist | Chicago Fire 2:19 Highlight Cruz Says Goodbye to Firehouse 51 | Chicago Fire 3:46 Highlight The FBI Calls In Severide for an Impossible Case | Chicago Fire Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google Key Takeaways
 Captain Kelly Severide and new recruit Marcus Burke were absent from Chicago Fire 's November 18, 2026, episode because they were attending firefighter training sessions at the Northeastern Illinois Public Safety Training Academy (NIPSTA).
 Stella Kidd stepped in as Firehouse 51's acting commanding officer during Severide's absence, impressing her colleagues with her leadership and efficiency.
 Severide is helping Burke prepare for his new role on Squad 8 following Joe Cruz's resignation in the show's milestone 300th episode. Their absence is temporary, and both are expected to return to Firehouse 51.
 The Firehouse 51 family is a tight knit crew, so you better believe it was noticed when Captain Kelly Severide (Taylor Kinney) was missing on Chicago Fire 's November 18 episode.
 How to Watch
 Watch Chicago Fire Wednesdays at 9 p.m. ET on NBC and next day on Peacock.
 Stream Now on Season 15 of Chicago Fire has been an action-packed watch as Firehouse 51 navigates a chapter of emotional changes. After Stella Kidd ( Miranda Rae Mayo ) trained a crew of dynamite candidates, Severide tapped Marcus Burke ( Da'Vinci ) to join Squad 8 after the station bid farewell to One Chicago icon Joe Cruz ( Joe Miñoso ) following his resignation in Chicago Fire 's milestone 300th episode . From new blood to bittersweet farewells, the action is only heating up on Chicago Fire , but 51's steadfast Captain and newest recruit were notably missing after the newcomer's exciting assignment, leading Stella to step up as the acting head of house during their time away.

 Where were Burke and Severide on Chicago Fire this week? (November 18, 2026)
 Lt. Kelly Severide (Taylor Kinney) and Marcus Burke (Da'Vinchi) in One Chicago press portraits. 
 Photo: Danny Ventrella/NBC Severide and Burke are temporarily OOO to attend sessions at Northeastern Illinois Public Safety Training Academy (NIPSTA), a training program for Illinois firefighters. In his absence, Severide tapped Stella to serve as 51's commanding officer. As one of the hardest workers in the CFD, she took to the post swimmingly.
 After showing up bright-eyed and bushy-tailed for a shift, Stella was happy to hand over some missing files to 51 veteran Randall Mouch ( Christian Stolte ), who was pleasantly surprised as he asked about a missing inspection. Stella proudly presented the file, telling Mouch she'd found it behind a filing cabinet.
 "Damn, look at you," Paramedic-in-Charge Violet Mikami ( Hanako Greensmith ) exclaimed. "Killing it as acting head of the house. It's not even nine."
 "Yeah, well, with the probies gone and Severide up at NIPSTA with Burke, I kind of didn't know what to do with myself this morning," Stella shrugged.
 "So you're saying it's a perfect time to bug you about new nozzles I've been looking at," Mouch teased.

 According to its website , NIPSTA is "an intergovernmental agency comprised of municipalities, fire protection districts, and other organizations located in the Chicago metropolitan area that have combined energies and resources to create a regional, state-of-the-art public safety training facility." 
 Sounds like Captain Severide is doing everything he can to ensure Burke is ready to hop aboard Squad 8 as 51's newest recruit, and Chihards can't wait to welcome them back.
